mask: R4 smoothed semantic material weights; 32ppc bilinear expansion from the renderer class field
phase: global world-cell origin; texture coordinate is worldCell*96 + outputPixel*3
blend: normal alpha composite over preserved ground; same RGB sampler used for north-support water backing
semanticMask: R4 _weights("water") from manifest-referenced smoothed semantic classgrid at 32px/cell
